items.definition: BANK_CURRENT_AND_SAVINGS_DEPOSITS: sum only explicitly disclosed current-account and savings-account balances belonging to the owner-approved issuer CASA definition. Demand deposits alone are not evidence of that sum. Do not include all term savings or Auto-Earning products by name; require their evidenced classification and inclusion/exclusion decision.
items.unit: Matching currency with approved scale; never percentages as balances

items.definition: BANK_CUSTOMER_DEPOSITS: gross customer-deposit balance for the identical issuer, reporting perimeter and as-of date. Exclude interbank, central-bank deposits and issued debt unless an explicitly approved issuer definition states otherwise; any departure must be separately labelled and owner-approved, not silently replace M3 denominator.
items.unit: Matching currency with approved scale; never percentages as balances

items.definition: BANK_NPL_AMOUNT: gross outstanding balance classified non-performing under the explicitly identified regulatory classification version/class set in the qualified disclosure, before deduction of reserves. Owner approves the enumerated class set and treatment of restructured, purchased, written-off/off-balance exposures; no unnamed regulatory convention or net-loan proxy is inferred.
items.unit: Matching currency with approved scale; never percentages as balances

items.definition: BANK_GROSS_CUSTOMER_LOANS: gross customer lending before impairment reserves, for the identical regulatory population, issuer, scope and as-of date. Interbank exposure, securities and non-customer credit are excluded unless explicitly included by the separately approved definition. Derived ratio requires both compatible operands.
items.unit: Matching currency with approved scale; never percentages as balances
